metadata.task: Transport the medicine box while keeping it upright.

plan.goal: Navigate to the Pharmacy Zone, locate and pick up the medicine box, transport it to the General Ward while maintaining an upright orientation, and place it on a designated surface.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Navigate to the Pharmacy Zone to access the medicine box.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is at the Main Entrance or Reception.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot is located at the Pharmacy Zone.

grounded_skills.reason: The robot requires navigation to the specific semantic location 'Pharmacy' to access the medicine box. This maps to the Nav2 action interface.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Locate the medicine box and estimate its pose.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is at the Pharmacy Zone.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot has detected the medicine box and estimated its 3D pose.

grounded_skills.reason: The robot must first detect the object instance in the scene to proceed with recognition and pose estimation.
The robot needs to classify the detected object as a 'medicine_box' to confirm the target identity.
The robot requires the precise 3D pose (position and orientation) of the medicine box to plan a valid grasp that keeps it upright.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Grasp the medicine box securely to maintain an upright orientation.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot has detected and localized the medicine box.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot is holding the medicine box in a stable, upright grasp.

grounded_skills.reason: The robot arm must move to a position above the medicine box to align the gripper for grasping.
The parallel gripper must close around the medicine box. The pose estimation from the previous step ensures the box is held upright.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Navigate to the General Ward with the medicine box.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is holding the medicine box at the Pharmacy Zone.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot is holding the medicine box at the General Ward.

grounded_skills.reason: The robot must navigate from the current location (Pharmacy) to the destination (General Ward). The navigation stack will avoid obstacles while carrying the load.

checkpoints.checkpoint_goal: Place the medicine box upright on a surface in the General Ward.
checkpoints.entry_state: Robot is holding the medicine box at the General Ward.
checkpoints.exit_state: Robot has placed the medicine box on a surface in the General Ward.

grounded_skills.reason: The robot must identify a valid surface (table) in the General Ward to place the object.
The robot arm must move to the detected table pose to position the object for placement.
The robot executes the placement action to release the medicine box onto the table, ensuring it remains upright.

constraints: Robot has limited payload capacity; ensure medicine box weight is within limits.
Robot has single arm only; cannot use two hands.
Robot cannot climb stairs; must navigate via corridors or elevators.
Robot cannot fly; must stay on the ground plane.
Robot cannot walk; relies on wheeled differential drive.
Ensure the 'upright' constraint is respected during grasp and place actions.

execution_summary.expected_outcome: The robot successfully navigates to the Pharmacy, detects and grasps the medicine box upright, transports it to the General Ward, and places it on a table.
